apis.summary: — Register a phone or glasses; pair glasses with phone
apis.details: Permission field.device.pair Idempotent yes, Idempotency-Key required SLO p95 150 ms Errors 409 FIELD-DEV-409-ALREADY-PAIRED: phone has another active pairing and replace is false 403 FIELD-DEV-403-REVOKED: phone device revoked Request {"kind": "glasses", "model": "meta-rayban-display", "display_capable": true, "firmware": "SAMPLE-1.0", "paired_with": "0193...phone"} Response {"id": "0193...gl", "status": "active", "pairing_id": "0193...pr"}

Permission device token (self) Idempotent yes, Idempotency-Key required SLO p95 80 ms Errors 403 FIELD-DEV-403-REVOKED: device revoked Request {"battery_pct": 64, "thermal": "none", "queue_depth": 3, "app_version": "0.2.0", "glasses": "connected"} Response {"config_version": 7}

Permission field.device.read Idempotent yes, Idempotency-Key required SLO p95 200 ms Errors 400 FIELD-REQ-400-LIMIT: limit above 200 Request ?site_id=&kind=&status=&stale=true&cursor=&limit=50 Response {"items": [{"id": "0193...", "kind": "phone", "model": "SAMPLE-PHONE", "last_seen_at": "2026-11-12T09:14:03Z", "battery_pct": 64, "queue_depth": 3, "stale": false}], "next_cursor": null}

apis.summary: — Effective server config for the device
apis.details: Permission device token (self) Idempotent yes, Idempotency-Key required SLO p95 60 ms Errors 304: unchanged Request ETag / If-None-Match Response {"version": 7, "preview_fps": 15, "auto_capture": true, "walking_quiet": false, "phone_camera_mode_allowed": true, "voice_locale": "en"}

apis.summary: — Revoke a device and its pairing
apis.details: Permission field.device.revoke + core step-up Idempotent yes, Idempotency-Key required SLO p95 300 ms Errors 428 FIELD-AUTH-428-STEP-UP: step-up missing 409 FIELD-DEV-409-ALREADY-REVOKED Request {"reason": "lost"} Response {"id": "0193...", "status": "revoked", "revoked_at": "2026-11-12T10:00:00Z"}

apis.summary: — Record consent per user, device and site
apis.details: Permission field.consent.record Idempotent yes, Idempotency-Key required SLO p95 100 ms Errors 422 FIELD-CON-422-VERSION: unknown consent version Request {"device_id": "0193...", "site_id": "0193...site", "consent_version": "f1-2026-11"} Response {"id": "0193...cn", "granted_at": "2026-11-12T08:00:00Z"}

apis.summary: — Compact expectations for ranking task match
apis.details: Permission field.task.read Idempotent yes, Idempotency-Key required SLO p95 100 ms Errors 404 FIELD-TASK-404: not found or out of scope Request ETag Response {"task_id": "0193...t", "lines": [{"task_line_id": "0193...l3", "codes": ["003012345678901232"], "gtin": "09506000134352", "object_class": "carton", "serial_pattern": null}]}

apis.summary: — Create a presigned crop upload (crops above 256 KB or backfill)
apis.details: Permission field.capture.create Idempotent yes, Idempotency-Key required SLO p95 80 ms Errors 413 FIELD-CAP-413-CROP-TOO-LARGE: above 1 MB Request {"sha256": "9f2c...", "bytes": 402113, "content_type": "image/jpeg"} Response {"upload_id": "0193...u", "put_url": "https://storage.example/...", "expires_at": "2026-11-12T09:19:03Z"}

apis.summary: — Ingest a capture (multipart: part meta JSON + part crop JPEG, or JSON with crop_upload_id)
apis.details: Permission field.capture.create; Idempotency-Key required Idempotent yes, Idempotency-Key required SLO p95 120 ms (excluding crop transfer) Errors 409 FIELD-CAP-409-DUPLICATE: same task, code type and code exists; body has duplicate_of 422 FIELD-IDEM-422-KEY-REUSE: same key, different body 422 FIELD-CAP-422-BLUR-MISSING: crop without blur_applied 422 FIELD-CAP-422-INVALID-SSCC: check digit fails 410 FIELD-CAP-410-TASK-CLOSED 403 FIELD-CAP-403-NO-CONSENT 413 FIELD-CAP-413-CROP-TOO-LARGE: inline crop above 256 KB Request {"idempotency_key": "01934f6e-7a10-7c3e-9b2a-5d1e8f0a4c21", "task_id": "0193...t", "client_seq": 42, "look_id": "0193...lk", "object_class": "carton", "code": "003012345678901232", "code_type": "sscc", "confidence": 0.97, "readability": 0.93, "rank_score": 0.81, "rank_detail": {"centre": 0.9, "task": 1.0, "read": 0.93, "cov": 1.0, "dwell": 1.0, "size": 0.3, "dup": false}, "blur_applied": true, "faces_blurred": 0, "timings": {"shutter": 0, "still_rx": 231, "decode_done": 268, "rank_done": 272, "committed": 281, "lens_drawn": 318}, "captured_at": "2026-11-12T09:14:03.120Z"} Response {"id": "0193...c", "task_line_id": "0193...l3", "on_task": true, "verify_status": "not_needed", "received_at": "2026-11-12T09:14:03.410Z"}

Permission field.capture.read Idempotent yes, Idempotency-Key required SLO p95 150 ms Errors 404 FIELD-CAP-404: not found or out of scope Request Response {"id": "0193...c", "code": "003012345678901232", "rank_detail": {"centre": 0.9}, "verify_status": "verified", "verify_model": "muse-spark-1.3", "timings": {"lens_drawn": 318}, "voice_events": []}

apis.summary: — Redirect to a 60 s signed crop URL; audited
apis.details: Permission field.evidence.read Idempotent yes, Idempotency-Key required SLO p95 100 ms Errors 410 FIELD-CAP-410-CROP-EXPIRED: deleted by retention 404 FIELD-CAP-404-CROP-WITHHELD Request Response {"status": 302, "location": "https://storage.example/...sig"}

Permission field.capture.create; Idempotency-Key required Idempotent yes, Idempotency-Key required SLO p95 100 ms Errors 422 FIELD-VOICE-422-ACCEPTED-BELOW-FLOOR: accepted true with confidence < 0.80 Request {"idempotency_key": "0193...v", "task_id": "0193...t", "capture_id": "0193...c", "transcript": "count twelve", "confidence": 0.91, "intent": "count", "args": {"n": 12}, "accepted": true, "locale": "en"} Response {"id": "0193...ve"}

Permission field.count.create; Idempotency-Key required Idempotent yes, Idempotency-Key required SLO p95 100 ms Errors 410 FIELD-CAP-410-TASK-CLOSED 422 FIELD-COUNT-422-RANGE: value outside 0-9999 for voice source Request {"idempotency_key": "0193...k", "task_line_id": "0193...l3", "capture_id": "0193...c", "kind": "count", "value": 12, "unit": "EA", "voice_event_id": "0193...ve"} Response {"id": "0193...cr"}

apis.summary: — Request posting after post and confirm
apis.details: Permission field.post.request + field.post.confirm; Idempotency-Key required Idempotent yes, Idempotency-Key required SLO p95 120 ms Errors 422 FIELD-POST-422-NO-CONFIRM: confirm missing, not accepted, not after post, other staged_hash or more than 10 s later 409 FIELD-POST-409-ALREADY-REQUESTED Request {"idempotency_key": "0193...p", "operation": "post", "lines": ["0193...l3"], "staged_hash": "b41e...", "post_voice_event_id": "0193...v1", "confirm_voice_event_id": "0193...v2"} Response {"posting_request_id": "0193...pr", "status": "queued", "event": "posting.requested"}

apis.summary: — Ticks and control messages; SSE fallback at GET /v1/devices/{id}/events with Last-Event-ID
apis.details: Permission device token (self) Idempotent yes, Idempotency-Key required SLO Tick fan-out p95 300 ms from event commit Errors 4401 close: token invalid or revoked 4409 close: second connection for device (older closed) Request ?last_event_id=0193...n41 Response {"id": "0193...n42", "kind": "verified", "subject_id": "0193...c", "payload": {"verify_status": "verified"}}
